name: AWS Securing Agent Identities Demonstrated

fee.note: Free on AWS Skill Builder; no subscription required.

exam.format: Timed hands-on lab in a live AWS environment on AWS Skill Builder covering agent identities and access (Bedrock AgentCore, Cognito, IAM, JWT and SigV4, CloudTrail). No multiple-choice questions; pass or fail, with a Credly badge on passing. Separate from AWS Certification exams; AWS suggests more than six months of experience in the topic.

free_routes.text: The assessment is free on AWS Skill Builder; no subscription required.

access.retake: Wait 25 days after a failed lab attempt before trying again; a microcredential that is still valid can be renewed from nine months after passing.

scope: Securing an AI agent's identities and access on AWS, including IAM and token-based authentication, in a timed hands-on lab.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: AWS calls the lab timed, but its public announcement and certification FAQ do not give the time limit.

prep.title: AWS Securing Agent Identities Demonstrated on AWS Skill Builder
prep.note: The assessment's page; AWS's FAQ says each microcredential page lists recommended preparation courses.
